SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS period
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS period
, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS order_amount_cent FROM tb_order WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{endExclusive} AND status IN (1, 2) GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS progress_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS canceled_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_id IS NOT NULL THEN user_id END) AS worker_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN task_status = 4 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, create_time, update_time) END), 2) AS average_completion_minutes FROM tb_task WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{endExclusive}
AND product_type_id = #{taskType}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_vending_machine WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND (running_status != '{"statusCode":"1001","status":true}' OR running_status IS NULL)

SELECT vm.inner_code AS inner_code, vm.vm_status AS vm_status, vm.running_status AS running_status, vm.update_time AS updated_at, vt.name AS vm_type_name FROM tb_vending_machine vm LEFT JOIN tb_vm_type vt ON vm.vm_type_id = vt.id WHERE vm.region_id = #{regionId} AND (vm.running_status != '{"statusCode":"1001","status":true}' OR vm.running_status IS NULL) ORDER BY vm.update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT vm.inner_code AS inner_code, vm.vm_status AS vm_status, vm.running_status AS running_status, vm.last_supply_time AS last_supply_time, vm.update_time AS updated_at, vm.region_id AS region_id, r.region_name AS region_name, vt.name AS vm_type_name FROM tb_vending_machine vm LEFT JOIN tb_vm_type vt ON vm.vm_type_id = vt.id LEFT JOIN tb_region r ON vm.region_id = r.id WHERE vm.inner_code = #{innerCode} AND vm.region_id = #{regionId} LIMIT 1
